description: This Java class, ProgressiveLoanScheduleGenerator, is part of the Apache Fineract project and is responsible for generating loan repayment schedules, especially for progressive or interest-only loans. It implements the LoanScheduleGenerator interface and manages the creation of detailed loan schedules, including handling disbursements, charges, interest calculations, and schedule rescheduling.

classes.name: ProgressiveLoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: A component that generates loan repayment schedules, including handling disbursements, interest calculations, and schedule adjustments for progressive loans within the Fineract system.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Creates a loan repayment schedule plan based on the provided loan terms and interest schedule model, returning a detailed schedule including principal, interest, fees, and penalties.

methods.name: rescheduleNextInstallments
methods.description: Reschedules the upcoming loan installments starting from a given date, returning the adjusted schedule data.

methods.name: calculatePrepaymentAmount
methods.description: Calculates the outstanding amounts for principal and interest if the borrower prepays early, considering the current state of the loan and interest recalculation preferences.

methods.name: getPeriodInterestTillDate
methods.description: Calculates the interest accrued on a specific installment up to a target date.
